}}'''Makzim''' is a [[Warder]] leading the training of aspiring Warder hopefuls at the [[Hall of the Tower under Egwene al'Vere|Reunited White Tower]].{{ref/book|c|Makzim}}

== Appearance ==
He is stern and thick-armed.

== Activities ==
He currently leads the Warder training sessions at the [[White Tower]].{{ref/book|13|22}} [[Gawyn Trakand|Gawyn]] approached Makzim to discuss the future of [[Younglings]] who wished to become soldiers rather than Warders bonded to new [[Aes Sedai]] sisters.

== Trivia ==
*Makzim is named for Maksim Zhukov, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''{{ref|Taglieri, Linda. {{Link |url=http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html |text=Character Names Derived From Readers' Names}}|thirteenth-depository}}
*In the [[The Wheel of Time (TV series)|television series]], there is a character named {{TVlink|Maksim}} portrayed by {{TVlink|Taylor Napier}}. However, the character is based on [[Owein]], who was renamed to avoid confusion with [[Owyn Merrilin|Owyn]].
